verdict.rationale: Segment documents a first-party Public API with token authentication, an OpenAPI spec and SDKs. Through it you can create, read, update and delete workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans without the UI, which supports headless automation. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or CI-specific workflows. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD integration or examples, non-interactive/service-account guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use the API to perform CRUD (create, read, update, and delete) operations at no extra charge. This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
The Segment Public API helps you manage your Segment Workspaces and its resources.
